description: This source file contains functions related to upgrading eMMC storage devices in an OpenWrt environment, including tar-based and FIT image-based upgrades, copying configurations, and initiating upgrades.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Performs upgrade of eMMC storage from a tar archive, handling kernel, root filesystem, and device tree blobs.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Performs upgrade of eMMC storage from a FIT image, writing the kernel directly to the device.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the eMMC device.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the type of upgrade image and delegates to the appropriate upgrade method.
